MVCC snapshot.summary: TL;DR: The search results reveal that Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) snapshots are used to manage visibility and access to data in various databases, including PostgreSQL and MariaDB. These snapshots are used to track the state of transactions and determine which data is visible or hidden at a given point in time. The pattern shows that MVCC snapshots are used to optimize concurrency and reduce contention between concurrent transactions.
